findings.title: text_ledger scan_c_like reports wrong line numbers for 1175 of 1899 JS comment units
findings.claim: tools/audit/text_ledger.py:scan_c_like loses one line each time a non-template string literal stops at a newline (break before line += 1, i = j + 1 consumes it), so the `line` column of 1175 of the seat's 1899 JavaScript comment units does not hold the unit's text (tests/card.mjs 690, policy_lint.mjs 353); Python units, numbered by tokenize, are 0 of 1200.
findings.mechanism: A quote inside a regex literal or a stray apostrophe opens a 'string' that ends at the newline; the newline is skipped without counting; the error accumulates down the file (card.mjs's DESIGN.md unit reports 10542, the text is at 10605). Ids are hashes, so `check` still passes and the defect is silent; a seat or fixer walking to a ledger row lands on the wrong code.
